Tigers defeat Blue Jays 6-5 in baseball game

The Detroit Tigers defeated the Toronto Blue Jays with a final score of 6-5. The Tigers secured the winning run in the later stages of the game when Zach McKinstry scored on an error. This victory came after the Blue Jays had held the Tigers to a no-hit bid for a significant portion of the game. The Blue Jays' pitcher Soriano was unable to maintain the no-hitter as the Tigers rallied late.
